Name: Please Remember My Birthday
Author: nraittanna
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#a64d79]Please, Remember My Birthday[/color]
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Birthdays aren't really important in Stardew Valley, and it seems like only the farmer cares about them, so this mod modifies the characters' schedules to make them actually remember their families/friends birthdays. 
[/size]
[b][size=5]Installation:
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patc[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]her[/url] must be installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[/size][size=3]Download the mod and unzip it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Place the folder [b][CP] Please, Remember My Birthday [/b]in your Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Features:
[/b][/size][size=3] Modifies the schedule of every NPC (with some exceptions), making them attend their relatives/friends' birthday. Check the articles to know the new schedules.[/size][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][size=5][b]Future updates:[/b]
[/size][size=3]I'm thinking of adding birthday events in the future, maybe write a couple of them for each character so that not every year you see the same event. Also, I'll be working on Sandy's birthday and making her attend Emily's birthday. If you have any other suggestions, please leave a comment to let me know!
[/size]
[size=5][b]﻿Compatibility:[/b][/size][size=3]
This mod shouldn't provoke any major bugs or be awfully incompatible with other mods. But have in mind that if you have other mods which modify schedules (I don't think there's any that modifies schedules in birthdays), they might overwrite each other.

It is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.

If you enjoy playing with my mods, please consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/nraittanna]buying me a coffee [/url][img]https://forums.nexusmods.com/public/style_emoticons/dark/smile.gif[/img]
[/size]
[size=4][center][b][color=#d5a6bd]Please let me know in the comments if you encounter any bug, and I hope you enjoy even more your experience in Stardew Valley with this mod![/color][/b][/center][/size][center][/center][size=4][center][/center][/size]
